paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Gittin 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.45b.2), raising an objection to Rav Ashi (as a colleague).[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rav Budya’s question to Rav Ashi about a Torah scroll. “As a colleague” is Hyman’s description.
